sources.license_note: Electronic Journal of Statistics open-access article; the journal marks the article under its open-access terms.
sources.read_status: Complete relevant units and proofs: §§1–4 and technical appendix lemmas used by the selected theorems.

sources.limitations: The test family Q_theta is formed by likelihood tilting relative to a KL minimizer and may be an unnormalized measure. The finite-dimensional BvM requires posterior contraction as a separate premise. A unique KL minimizer and testability are not automatic on noncompact parameter spaces.
